name: Stride
author: E. T. Carter
description: Bold diagonal bars sliding across the frame, each a beveled ridge with a lit chamfer and shadowed trailing edge so they read as extruded 3D slats. Confident, architectural, kinetic.

params.label: Bar count
params.effect: How many bars span the frame; low is bold and massive, high a fine louvre.

params.label: Slide speed
params.effect: How fast the bars slide; 0 holds them still.

params.label: Bevel
params.effect: Width of the chamfered edges; low is a flat slat, high a fully rounded ridge.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer tilts the bars; 0 ignores the mouse.
